name: t12-v2
title: Implant attempted speech (T12): causal GRU-CTC phoneme decoder v2 (M3-28)
task: attempted-speech phoneme decoding, CTC over 39 ARPAbet phonemes + word boundary

input.features: tx1 (threshold crossings) + spikePow of 256 electrodes, z-scored per trial with the 20 previous trials of the session (clip |z| <= 10)
input.file_note: competitionData/test/t12.YYYY.MM.DD.mat (the train file of the same session must be in ../train/ for the rolling normalisation)
input.session: required: the session name selects the per-session day layer

licence.weights_status: CC0 1.0 (user decision D11, 2026-11-22). Not released yet: the upload as a GitHub release asset (D10) waits for a final user yes (P14-02, gap 98). Never in the wheel or the git repository
licence.attribution: Data: Willett et al., Nature 2023, Brain-to-Text '24 competitionData, Dryad doi:10.5061/dryad.x69p8czpq (CC0 1.0)

training.data: Brain-to-Text '24 competitionData, participant T12 (Willett et al. 2023)
training.split: train blocks of all 24 sessions except the last train block of each session (validation); the test blocks ('pool') never trained the decoder

metrics.name: greedy PER
metrics.split: test blocks of the 10 test sessions (400 trials)

limits: One participant (T12). The day layer exists only for the 24 sessions of the dataset.
The rolling normalisation needs the earlier trials of the same session (the train file).
Weaker than t15-m4-13 (PER 0.27 against 0.12). Offline replay only.
trust_note: The committed T12 guards (P6-02, P14-03) were calibrated with a word decoder that also uses a Tatoeba word trigram LM (experiments/2026-11-13-confirmatory-t12-v2/wordlm.py). That LM is not packaged yet (open gap). Pass your own decode_fn to fidetype.trust.calibrate instead.

hosting.notes: no download URL yet; hosting is the user step P14-02 (docs/publishing-checklist.md)
